description: Skelet AF-14d: product/version gallery reads with actor-scoped visibility (MCP plus REST plus skill plus CI wiring)

compatibility.instructions: Does this grain preserve all contracts: skelet.agent.v1 envelope unchanged, existing tools/routes/rankings untouched, two new tools additive with MCP/REST deep-equal parity, inventory 22->24 updated in three tests, skill validator promotion, CI db suite gains one file? Any renamed tool, changed route, or altered behavior?

correctness.instructions: Is the gallery correct: products/versions listed only with >=1 actor-readable artifact via the central gate (same predicate family as flows), unknown products read as empty with no oracle, malformed IDs fail invalid-input, deterministic title/id and version_no ordering with examined caps and truncation flags, version IDs feeding flow/change tools? Do the 6 db tests plus 3 transport tests prove counts, visibility, pagination, validation, isolation, determinism, and parity?

evidence.instructions: Is evidence sufficient: db 133/133 (6 new), web/node/worker 128/128 (3 new), python 217/217, validators PASS, lint/typecheck clean on db plus web, graft green, CI wired for exact-head proof? Any passing-test-only claim without integration coverage?

reliability.instructions: Any nondeterminism or resource risk: per-entity gate checks bounded by examined caps (200) with truncation flags, stable orders, limit 1..50 with offset cap, read-only queries, no timeouts needed for bounded local reads?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond bounded gallery reads: gallery UI, flow player, taxonomy, rrweb, embeddings, billing, transplants, or unrelated refactors? Are those explicitly still open?

security.instructions: Do the R2 guarantees hold: per-artifact central-gate checks before listing (private and orphan titles never in JSON on either transport), unknown and withheld products answer alike as empty, malformed IDs fail invalid-input identically on both transports, request IDs/cursors sanitized, error bodies static with leak assertions, no shell/subprocess/network?
